authorization_scope: Independent audit and this JSON only; no edits to source, no training, no test execution, no publication.

contracts.contract: Diagnostic complete-cohort transport only: 1..64 rows, 16MiB input, full seven facets, no silently dropped failed TRAIN row, explicit train/tuning identity and normalized-source disjointness, TRAIN-only vocabulary. Word source/target cap 64 remains distinct from byte output cap 512. Exact source/context anchors and scope declaration are owner-validated; occurrence loss or flat normalization is refused. Every training/semantic/Lean authority flag stays false. Review receipt replay is not training authority; review-to-cohort/family applicability/native floor remain unassessed.

Pinned summary has no new reviewed TRAIN qualifier pairs, 0 labels/formal targets admitted, 0 authenticated human/independent reviews in review34/review64, and zero supervision masks. Authored engineering targets must retain their distinct provenance.

V2 receives only source_text plus explicit modal_scope, and emits learned support, 2..8 member count/scope/O-P-F and actor/action pointers. There are no object/conditions/exceptions/temporal heads. Unsupported-source batches update shared/support only; structural moments may be idle. Inference must not call source parser, targets, reference groups or legacy fallback. Current head cannot acquire qualifier coverage through a data-only continuation.

Grouped checkpoint v2 is closed finite CPU float32 JSON, contains producer/torch/tokenizer/profile pins, numerical model+AdamW state and bounded global steps, never sources/targets. Shared/support Adam count proves each declared step; structural parameters have consistent bounded counts including idle all-negative histories. Restore validates shapes/moments/counts/pins and exact resave. Next-update replay is tested. Changed producer rejects old checkpoint; architectural addition requires a new version and explicit initialization/migration.

source_checkpoint_continuation_v1 restores prior selected weights but deliberately uses a fresh optimizer: exact_optimizer_resume false, optimizer_state_inherited false, initial optimizer entries zero. It cannot substantiate exact Adam resume.

Existing numerical owner increments steps only after optimizer.step and finite-state checks, records committed per-step row IDs, target-token/source-value presentations, loss/gradient/LR, and reports initial/selected/final-attempt tensor hashes plus split/reference/codec hashes. This is the usable custody pattern; a requested budget or zero-step adapter is not trained-model evidence.

Current normative wording recipe derives new prose only from original TRAIN rules and hard-refuses nonempty qualifiers. 12 historical source inventories plus separately sealed prospective development exclusions bind the comparison. Native 384D/768D source preparation requires real offline local encoder assets; fake deterministic vectors are not fidelity evidence. The recipe is suitable for a modality wording control, not qualifier learning unless a new explicitly versioned complete-qualifier owner is implemented.

Scope owner preserves exact source/context typed occurrences, ordered rule attachment and bounded Boolean/binder declarations, requiring every occurrence to be attached. Structural validation never authenticates meaning; nested/repeated/ordered scopes must not be sorted, deduplicated or flattened for successful training transport.

Complete source-bound caller interpretation declares every condition and exception in original order, exact temporal literal/clock/units, and exception scope (activation waiver or per-tick exemption). These are declared authored premises, not inferred source meanings. Missing interpretation/unsupported duration retains blockers. Family training v7/native Lake v5 and source-bound legal_qualified_lake are existing routes; toy interpretation success grants no source fidelity.

recommended_experiment.alternative: A matched source-wording comparison is feasible for the existing 384D modality task, retaining native offline cache/asset evidence and exact zero replay. For qualifiers, first implement a new authored complete-qualifier source/codec/training profile; the current owner must continue to reject nonempty qualifiers. Do not present the current 32-token grammar or untrained adapter as qualifier fidelity.
recommended_experiment.control_design: Use same architecture/initial seed/optimizer/batch order and bounded update count for two registered arms. Prefer a zero-weight control plus a single qualifier-loss change or no-qualifier auxiliary versus complete qualifier auxiliary; report unsupported/control limitations. Old v2 head is a retention baseline, not a matched qualifier architecture. Freeze support threshold and selection criterion before fitting.
recommended_experiment.final_barrier: After all selections are durably fixed, reference-blind inference persists every prediction before parsing final reference bodies; score once. Do not tune after final results; exposed final becomes retention evidence for any subsequent run.
recommended_experiment.fit_custody: Record successful optimizer-step sequence, batch/source/reference bindings, per-facet losses and nonzero trained-parameter changes; increment steps only after actual finite optimizer.step. Save zero, scheduled, selected and last-attempt endpoints with tensor hashes and real Adam moments. No padded/fabricated counter; zero-step adapter is untrained. Any old-weight initialization with new architecture/fresh optimizer must say warm start, not exact resume.
recommended_experiment.labels: Declare authored generation recipe/meaning premises first, then retain complete canonical or occurrence-aware targets and offsets separately from model inputs. Reserve nonempty conditions, exceptions, temporal and mixed facets across O/P/F. Mark legal_gold false, source_semantics_reviewed false, broad_proof_ready false, and canonical train_eligible unchanged false. A semantic review receipt or source-anchored encoding is not a legal-label gold source.
recommended_experiment.preferred: New opt-in, versioned source-anchored qualifier head over separately authored complete fixtures.
recommended_experiment.rationale: It directly tests learned complete qualifier pointers/type/attachment without relying on unavailable semantic-gold admission or the empty-qualifier normative grammar. Raw UTF-8 source input avoids unnecessary encoder provenance for this first structural experiment.
recommended_experiment.schema_before_fit: Closed source-only inference input; complete output includes modality, actor, action, object, condition/exception/temporal occurrence lists and explicit rule attachments. Use exact half-open Unicode character spans with byte/token mapping checks. Do not silently invent empty fields, normalize qualifier connective/order, or return partially projected success. Unsupported contexts/scopes get explicit support refusal.
recommended_experiment.scoring: Complete exact-case fidelity across all seven facets plus exact occurrence/rule-attachment where applicable, per-facet omission/hallucination, source-span exactness, support confusion and learned refusal versus incidental downstream block. Report every row, rejection and out-of-profile source. Lean validity and source fidelity remain separate metrics.
recommended_experiment.source_and_label_reservation: Seal complete TRAIN, selection, final source groups and reference hashes before fitting. Group parent legal document, literal/normalized text, clause/paragraph aliases, context and paraphrase/meaning ancestry. Exclude all prior named inventories and exposed 14-US-probe/old-regression/final references. Source inventories must stay full, including rejected rows; never discard hard qualifiers. Explain if held-out wording reuses exposed authored meanings. Vocabulary and hyperparameters fit TRAIN/selection only.
